schools.source: Existing game school-calendar.ts: common K–5, grades 6–8, grades 9–12 and a shared fall calendar. NCES CCD public schools by place and county (opening-schools.json, from the P12 state files) supply each child's campus among the schools teaching their entry grade, weighted by this world's students per grade; they are recent identities, not historical attendance or historical existence. Every world names each campus itself (past-school-names.ts; owner, Oct 27: no real school's name ships), never with the name of a real school near the person, read from the directory's shortened form as people say it.
